column1: # CheckerNearMissSweepTest's clusters: every key under which the checker and A12 disagree on a seed rule or a
# single edit of it — verdict, A12's classes, the checker's classes (docs/CONFORMANCE-PLAN.md, M1). A fix deletes
# its rows; a new row is a new defect. Counts and example mutants are in build/checker-near-miss/report.tsv.
